env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# One declaration-owned package const-map materialization: lib declares M,
# main reads it ordinarily and through a comptime generic, and the ejected
# tree reads it again. The declaration is emitted once in lib; every
# consumer references it.
cd m
logos build -o $WORK/bin/ownedonce$GOEXE ./app
exec $WORK/bin/ownedonce$GOEXE
stdout '^ok lookup$'
stdout '^ok native-lookup$'
stdout '^ok comptime-lookup$'
stdout '^ok materialized-once$'
cp stdout $WORK/want.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/app/main.go
exists out/lib/lib.go
# Exactly one table materialization in the whole tree, owned by lib.
# The importer holds only thin wrappers that reference lib's exported helpers.
grep -count=1 'ConstTable\[int, int\]' out/lib/lib.go
! grep 'ConstTable\[int, int\]' out/app/main.go
grep -count=1 'LogosCM_M_lookup' out/lib/lib.go
grep 'LogosCM_M_lookup' out/app/main.go
cd out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
go run ./app
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/cmownedonce

go 1.27

-- m/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import "comptime"

const M = map[int]int{0: 0, 1: 10, 2: 20, 3: 30, 4: 40, 5: 50, 6: 60, 7: 70, 8: 80}

func Native(k int) int {
	return M[k] ?? -1
}

type Marker struct{ N int }

func Get[T any](k int) int {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return M[k] ?? -1
	}
	return -2
}

func Materialized() map[int]int {
	var m map[int]int = M
	return m
}

func CMaterialized[T any]() map[int]int {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		var m map[int]int = M
		return m
	}
	return map[int]int{}
}

-- m/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"example.com/cmownedonce/lib"
)

func fail(msg string) {
	fmt.Println("FAIL " + msg)
	os.Exit(1)
}

func main() {
	if (lib.M[4] ?? -1) != 40 {
		fail("lookup")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok lookup")
	if lib.Native(4) != 40 {
		fail("native-lookup")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok native-lookup")
	if lib.Get[lib.Marker](4) != 40 {
		fail("comptime-lookup")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok comptime-lookup")
	a := lib.Materialized()
	b := lib.CMaterialized[lib.Marker]()
	if fmt.Sprintf("%p", a) != fmt.Sprintf("%p", b) {
		fail("materialized-once")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok materialized-once")
}
